svg.title: Controlled changes in ornament structure
svg.desc: Each row compares the reference on the left and a changed structure on the right at the same tick scale. Dashed strokes mean motion with no material deposited.
svg.text: The drawing can survive while a promise fails
Reference at left, change at right. Shared scale per pair. Two periods. Dashed: motion without a deposit.
Switch off deposition at the sixth stroke, preserving the movement sites and later marks.
Switch off the final stroke in each repeat.
After the third reach, return along it and trace it forward again before continuing.
Increase only one inner horizontal reach from one tick to two.
Multiply every bound reach by two.
Exchange the vertical frame for its opposite.
